ad_account_id.title: Ad Account ID
ad_account_id.description: LinkedIn Ads account ID (numeric or full URN like urn:li:sponsoredAccount:123).

date_start.title: Date Start
date_start.description: Start date of the sync range. Use 'last_run' (default) to continue from the last run date (falls back to 365 days on first run), or any value supported by dateparser: 'today', '7 days ago', '1 month ago', '1 year ago', or an absolute date 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

date_end.title: Date End
date_end.description: End date of the sync range. Use 'today' (default), or any value supported by dateparser: '1 day ago', '1 month ago', or an absolute date 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
